meta.title: Why Credit Card Companies Offer You 0% Interest
meta.hook: A credit card company offering you 0% interest is betting you won't actually pay it off in time.
meta.description: Balance transfer cards let you move existing credit card debt onto a new card at 0% interest for a limited promotional window, usually charging an upfront transfer fee of a few percent. The offer works for the issuer because a meaningful share of balances aren't fully paid off before the promotional period ends, after which the remaining balance starts accruing interest at the card's regular rate. Educational content only, not financial advice.
